metadata.description:
Charming and serene, Lake Harriet is where music floats from the bandshell, vintage streetcars hum nearby, and serenity lives around every bend of the trail. It’s the lake for long walks, kite festivals, and a stop at the famous bread-and-ice-cream-serving bandshell café. The perfect blend of urban and nostalgic, it invites you to slow down and take it all in. You’ve earned this Lake Lover POAP for soaking in the classic Minneapolis vibe on your 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Lake Lover 
GPS: 44.92812, -93.30774 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.92812,-93.30774
